subject.title: feat(qwen): add Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as an official qwen provider/config/auth contract in the externalized qwen plugin?
rationale: The implementation is concrete and well-proven, but it adds a public provider id, onboarding auth choices, env var, model catalog/default, and outbound hosts that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product surface.

options.title: Accept After Catalog Refresh
options.body: Regenerate the generated catalog/reference surfaces, resolve the review finding, and let the qwen plugin own Token Plan onboarding as an official provider path.

options.title: Route Outside Core
options.body: Pause or close this PR and ask for Token Plan support through an external plugin if maintainers do not want another official Alibaba provider contract.

options.title: Wait For Stronger Vendor Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open but require maintainer-selected model and region proof before accepting the official provider surface.

recommendation.title: Accept After Catalog Refresh
recommendation.body: Regenerate the generated catalog/reference surfaces, resolve the review finding, and let the qwen plugin own Token Plan onboarding as an official provider path.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is the live PR assignee and the strongest current-main history signal for the qwen provider/catalog surfaces.
